description: KID四兵攻击 E76 — 关闭中心，双翼竞赛

intro.popup_en: On move seven, d5 closes the center and divides the board. White attacks on the kingside, Black on the queenside: each side fights on its own wing.
intro.popup:
第7步d5关闭中心，棋盘被分割成两半。
白方攻王翼，黑方攻后翼，各打各的！

outro.popup_en: After d5 closes the center, the two sides' space becomes separated. Closing the center is one of the most common ways to divide the board and define opposite-wing plans.
outro.popup:
d5关门后双方空间各自独立。
关闭中心是空间分割最常见的方式。

moves.popup_en: d4 occupies the center and prepares a broad pawn formation.
moves.popup:
▶️ d4
白方先占中心，准备建立强大的兵中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 begins the King's Indian Defense. Black develops a knight without contesting the center immediately, waiting for White to advance before counterattacking.
moves.popup:
▶️ Nf6
国王印度防御！黑方先出马，暂时不争中心
等白方充分推进后再反击

moves.popup_en: c4 adds the second pawn to White's broad center. Together, c4 and d4 control many central squares.
moves.popup:
▶️ c4
白方建立大型兵中心的第二步
c4+d4控制了大量中心格子

moves.popup_en: ...g6 prepares ...Bg7, where the bishop will target White's large pawn center indirectly rather than challenge it head-on.
moves.popup:
▶️ g6
黑方准备用飞象（Bg7）来攻击白方大型兵中心
间接地反击，不是正面冲突

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops and supports d4 and e4, preparing White's next central advance.
moves.popup:
▶️ Nc3
白方出马，支援d4和e4
为接下来的e4推进做准备

moves.popup_en: ...Bg7 fianchettoes the bishop, which targets d4 along the long diagonal. White's center is under pressure and must be handled carefully.
moves.popup:
▶️ Bg7
黑方飞象！象在g7对角线上射击d4
白方的中心在压力下，必须提高警惕

moves.popup_en: e4! White builds a huge center with c4, d4, and e4, reaching maximum space. This is the striking four-pawn setup.
moves.popup:
🚀 e4 — 白方建立超大中心！
c4+d4+e4，白方控制的空间达到顶峰
这是「四兵攻击」中最壮观的局面

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's position, supports e5, and prevents White from advancing further without preparation.
moves.popup:
▶️ d6
黑方稳固阵型，准备反击
d6支撑e5，防止白方进一步推进

moves.popup_en: f4! White completes the four-pawn attack with c4, d4, e4, and f4. The space is impressive, but Black is under considerable pressure to strike back.
moves.popup:
🚀 f4 — 四兵攻击成型！
c4+d4+e4+f4，白方建立了4个连锁中心兵
黑方的压力极大！

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king and prepares a counterattack against White's broad center.
moves.popup:
▶️ O-O
黑方易位！王安全后可以展开反击
黑方准备打击白方的大中心

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and coordinates White's position, supporting the central formation.
moves.popup:
▶️ Nf3
白方出马，进一步协调阵型
整个阵型开始配合推进

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black attacks d4 and forces White to make a decision. If White advances d5, the center will close and the race on opposite wings begins.
moves.popup:
⚡ c5 — 黑方的反击！
攻击白方d4，迫使白方做出选择
若白方d5：中心关闭，双翼竞赛开始

moves.popup_en: d5! White closes the center instead of exchanging. The board is divided: White can expand on the kingside with f4-f5, while Black seeks queenside play.
moves.popup:
🔑 d5！关闭中心！
白方不交换，推进d5！
棋盘被一分为二：
• 白方在王翼扩展（f4-f5）
• 黑方在后翼扩展（e6-c4-b5）

moves.popup_en: ...e6 immediately counterattacks the d5-pawn, aiming to open the center or gain space.
moves.popup:
▶️ e6
黑方立刻发动反击！
攻击d5兵，尝试打开中心或获得空间

moves.popup_en: Be2 develops and prepares castling. White continues calmly without being distracted by Black's pressure.
moves.popup:
▶️ Be2
白方出象，为易位做准备
稳步发展，不为黑方的牵制所动

moves.popup_en: ...exd5 exchanges White's d5-pawn and opens the e-file. The space contest becomes more dynamic.
moves.popup:
▶️ exd5
黑方换掉d5兵，打开e列
双方的空间竞赛变得更加紧张

moves.popup_en: cxd5 recaptures and leaves White with a strong pawn on d5, supporting a kingside advance. Black seeks counterplay on the queenside while White plans on the kingside: the race is on, and the side that acts first may gain the edge.
moves.popup:
✅ cxd5 — 最终局面！
c兵来吃回d5，白方保持d5强兵！
• 白方d5是后续王翼推进的支柱
• 黑方在后翼（c4-b5）和王翼（f5）展开竞赛
双翼竞赛正式开始，谁先动手谁占优！
